summary: LP long writes work on a settled, static panel; ACL readback followed both LP and HS changes.
A bright-content retained-supply wake failed with correct drive/link register values; a fresh frame did not recover it.
Deferring continuous DSI clocks until after reset release and TCON_RDY corrected two boots with the fixup disabled. Both physical observations and register readbacks passed.
Cutting panel power and repeating initialization recovered bright content. Package 27 uses this full lifecycle and removes the timer fixup and retained-supply blanking interface.
Fresh package-27 recovery showed correct colours; the filesystem button, five touch targets and controlled Power/touch wake passed.

An immediate off/on exposed a powered-host race in package 27. Package 28 rearms LP11 on every bridge pre-enable; three immediate cycles retained all eight expected register values, with no frame kickoffs during readback.

LP_write_test.method: KD_GRAPHICS, paused screen daemon, zero frame kickoffs; B0/B2 plus update key, interleaved known D8 controls
LP_write_test.conclusion: No blanket LP-write failure on a settled panel.

bright_retained_supply_wake.conclusion: The measured settings were retained despite visible wake failure; lost ACL/ELVSS alone does not explain it.

clock_order_experiment.modules: linux-tabs3 6.19.5-26; same kernel release/config, no MODVERSIONS
clock_order_experiment.changes: Defer clock force on both hosts until the first panel command; that command follows TCON_RDY. Added timestamped checkpoints. Other panel initialization unchanged.
clock_order_experiment.controls: fixup=0, screen daemon masked, no manual fixup
clock_order_experiment.first_user_observation: this is better ! even the loading console text was perfect from the begining ! not generish then good
clock_order_experiment.comparison: The same addresses were 1d/02/e5/08/0f/10/00/99 on two earlier fixup-disabled package-25 boots.
clock_order_experiment.limits: No oscilloscope measurement or internal DDI latch decoding. The controlled software clock ordering is a demonstrated corrective cause, not proof of an exact undocumented electrical mechanism.

full_power_cycle.method: fb0/blank 4 then 0, keep_vdd=0 on test modules; real unchanged recovery image

driver_changes: HS tear/display-off followed by reset low, supply off and 25 ms wait
Remove the failing raw DCS backlight power interface; userspace uses DRM/fbdev blanking
recovery_changes: Decorative LVGL containers do not intercept button taps
Wake gesture drained and consumed through release
Final initramfs explicitly sets initial framebuffer blank state

five_point_touch.limit: Coarse targeting and orientation, not stylus precision or multi-touch.

physical_checks.controlled_wake_log: Only Screen off requested / Screen on requested added; filesystem action count unchanged at 2
physical_checks.initial_wake_trial: User reported stable wake with no extra check, but the log included another action; repeated under explicit one-tap/no-more-input instructions to remove ambiguity.
physical_checks.Power_hold_return_to_Debian: User: Yes, Debian console is clear

validation.known_build_warning: depmod initramfs lacks modules.builtin.modinfo; pre-existing packaging metadata warning

remaining_limits: Fixed calibrated 360-nit brightness; lower gamma/AID levels and temperature-based panel voltage settings unimplemented.
GPIO121 error-line/ESD recovery unimplemented; pull-down-low is not proof of a trip.
System suspend and long endurance unqualified.
DPU logs disabled-encoder / -EWOULDBLOCK wait during full wake; no visible failure accompanied it. Review upstream ordering separately.
Occasional pixel-clock RCG warnings also occurred before this change.
Charging thermal/charger-detection work remains a functional test, not a full-charge or thermal-soak qualification.
final_image_validation: Both package-28 partitions flushed and hash-verified, recovery build #13 booted, three immediate panel cycles passed readback, and remote recovery exit returned to Debian build #13 with no failed services. A subsequent fresh package-28 recovery boot passed physical colour and stable Power/touch wake observation; the user clarified the filesystem check was a separate intentional tap after waking.

rapid_wake_regression.trigger: fbdev blank 4 immediately followed by 0, before the 200 ms DSI host runtime autosuspend
rapid_wake_regression.cause: Powered hosts skip dsi_ctrl_config, leaving continuous clocks enabled during the next reset sequence.
rapid_wake_regression.correction: Patch 0030 calls begin_lp11_init for both DSI hosts on every bridge pre-enable, before panel preparation, including already-powered hosts.

rapid_cycles.clock_log: Both powered hosts rearmed at lane_ctrl=00000000 before reset release; both start at 10000000 after TCON_RDY.
rapid_cycles.test_setup: Recovery UI paused during off/on and readback, one framebuffer write after wake, then UI resumed. Earlier attempts stopped because tracefs/debugfs were not mounted; only the complete three-cycle run is counted.

physical_checks.prior_validation: The unchanged recovery UI passed filesystem-button, five-point touch, consumed-wake-gesture and Power-hold checks on package 27. User confirmation of clear Debian corresponds to that preceding boot; live package-28 recovery was still running when it arrived.
physical_checks.earlier_attempt: No reply received to the final package-28 colour/Power/touch observation before returning to Debian. Do not count this as an additional physical pass.
physical_checks.status: Passed on a fresh package-28 recovery boot: correct colours, steady picture and stable Power/touch wake.
physical_checks.user_observation: Correct colours; stable wake; no check runs
physical_checks.user_clarification: my mistake i clicked check system after it wakup
physical_checks.action_log: Screen off requested; Screen on requested; Recovery action: Check filesystem
physical_checks.interpretation: User confirmed the check was a separate intentional tap after wake. The log contains an action, so it is not an unchanged-action-count test. This validates visible startup/wake; the earlier package-27 controlled no-extra-tap trial verified gesture consumption.

final_Debian.clock_startup: Both clocks deferred through reset release and TCON_RDY; no timed fixup

post_visual_return.sampling_note: Sample taken immediately after boot; net battery current is negative despite charging enabled. This is not a new steady-state charging test.
